brief.audience: Freelancers in the US, UK and Canada who do their own bookkeeping
brief.problem: Freelancers lose evenings every quarter matching receipts to bank transactions
brief.solution: Ledgerly sorts bank transactions into income and expenses automatically and matches receipts you snap with your phone
differentiators: Shows what to set aside for taxes every time you get paid
facts: Free for 30 days, then $12 per month
Connects to your bank with read-only access through Plaid
Exports everything to CSV or sends it to your accountant in one click
